name: Black tea
description: Fully oxidized tea — the base of desi chai and Arab shai.

tcm.note: Oxidation warms it: hong cha is the winter tea.

ayurveda.note: Oxidation reads as ushna, the same logic fermentation gets elsewhere in this set — green tea's astringent-bitter coolness doesn't survive it.

unani.note: Chai is treated as garam in desi usage.

histamine.note: SIGHI marks black tea for histamine content as well as for blocking DAO — the only tea it scores above green.

stimulant.note: Fully oxidised: less theanine than green tea, and tannins that appear to slow how quickly the caffeine lands.

effects.note: Trials pairing L-theanine with caffeine report calmer, steadier attention than caffeine alone — the doses studied run supplement-strength, above what one cup delivers. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
